adaptation.description: Published MaleCNS T1 neuron selection, neuron sizes, presynaptic sign and nonzero VNC edge mask; retained edges use exact current MaleCNS v1.0 full-CNS synapse counts >=5. This is an adaptation, not an exact reproduction of the published network or VNC-only counts. No edges absent from the published mask are added.
adaptation.excluded_reason: Untraced sensory body absent from the imported Traced population; silent in reproduced published baseline.
adaptation.scope: Both front-leg neuropils only; no middle/hind CPG and no claim of coordinated gait.

parameters.parameter_choice: Deterministic published distribution means; no sampled or fitted per-cell physiology.
